Synopsis:
The article covers heat-related vulnerabilities in UK rail infrastructure — rail warping ("sun kink"), overhead line drooping, and signalling cabinet overheating — and discusses mitigation technologies such as auto-tensioning and passive heat exchangers (IsoMat). The broader point is that hotter summers driven by climate change will increase frequency of these issues, requiring infrastructure investment.
